notes: §1985:IX.3.2.2 prints the indexed FD: FD file-name-1, then BLOCK CONTAINS, the three RECORD forms ("IS VARYING IN SIZE" among them), LABEL {RECORD IS | RECORDS ARE} {STANDARD | OMITTED}, VALUE OF {implementor-name-1 IS {data-name-2 | literal-1}} ... and DATA {RECORD IS | RECORDS ARE} {data-name-3} ..., in any order (§1985:IX.3.2.3 SR2). The grammar rules named are that format since kb/Work PB5070 landed (labelRecordsClause takes only STANDARD or OMITTED, valueOfClause is valueOfEntry+ with implementor-name-1 before each operand); BindFileSection takes the indexed format from the SELECT and FileDescriptionClauseAdmitted refuses from Rows what Format 2 lacks (COBOL2604), ScreenClauseRepetition a repeated clause (COBOL2423), VisitUnrecognizedClause any other word (COBOL1970), VisitRecordClause the 2023 BYTES spelling, Slots a zero integer; LABEL, VALUE OF and DATA RECORDS are refused from 2002 (COBOL0902/COBOL0873). Probed at --std 85 over an indexed file, 2026-11-14 tree dc1f2dcce8: (b) eight legal entries (every optional word dropped, CONTAINS integer TO integer, VARYING with and without FROM/TO/DEPENDING, VALUE OF with two entries, DATA RECORDS naming two 01s, EXTERNAL, GLOBAL) run OK; refused: BLOCK, RECORD, LABEL, VALUE OF, DATA written twice (COBOL2423), LABEL RECORDS ARE IGNORED and LABEL STANDARD (COBOL5506), VALUE OF "F1DATA" (COBOL5506), VALUE OF with no entry and VALUE OF FILE-ID IS with no operand (COBOL0001), DATA RECORD IS with no name (COBOL0001), DATA RECORD IS K (an 05, COBOL6849), VALUE OF FILE-ID IS NOSUCH (COBOL1639), BLOCK CONTAINS RECORDS with no integer (COBOL5506), CODE-SET, LINAGE, FORMAT, ACCESS MODE (COBOL2604), RECORDING MODE (COBOL1970), zero integers (COBOL2386), a data-name integer (COBOL1547), BLOCK -4; (c) BYTES and EXTERNAL AS literal refused (COBOL0900), and LABEL, VALUE OF and DATA RECORDS refused at 2002, 2014 and 2023; (a) an ODO record under RECORD VARYING DEPENDING ON and RECORD CONTAINS 6 TO 11 wrote and read 7- and 11-character records, the DEPENDING item drove the written length; (e) on a relative file the same clauses compile and run, and after a failed OPEN INPUT (status 35) a READ gives 47. The prior PARTIAL (LABEL operands and VALUE OF shape unchecked) is fixed. The witness writes and reads an indexed record under BLOCK, RECORD, LABEL and DATA RECORD clauses and displays 0001ALPHAB. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5070 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-03.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-03-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985 indexed FD: BLOCK CONTAINS, RECORD (CONTAINS / VARYING / integer-6 TO integer-7), LABEL RECORDS, VALUE OF, DATA RECORDS. §2023:13.4.5.2 Format 2 (relative-or-indexed) keeps FD file-name-1, BLOCK CONTAINS (restated in §2023:13.18.10.2) and record-clause (§2023:13.18.43.2, which also admits BYTES), but carries no LABEL RECORDS, VALUE OF or DATA RECORDS clause: a 1985 program using them (obsolete in 1985) is refused under 2023. EXTERNAL and GLOBAL are not new, 1985 X.4.2.2 already had them; only EXTERNAL AS literal-1 is. Compile-time only.
